properties.decision:
SUBORDINATE RULING. This does NOT re-decide the retro question. `dec:the-patch-record-binds-forward-not-backward` settled that on 2026-08-17 — forward only, no backfill — and this node sits under it, narrowing one boundary the parent could not have fixed because the instrument did not exist yet.

WHAT THE PARENT FIXED: the requirement binds on fixes recorded from 2026-08-17.
WHAT THIS FIXES: the CAUSE-EDGE half of it binds from 2026-09-06.

THEY ARE DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTS AND THAT IS THE WHOLE CONTENT OF THIS NODE. The requirement has two limbs and they shipped three weeks apart:
  • the REPAIR DISPOSITION on record_change (corrected_cause / contained_symptom), read by `repair_report` — shipped 2026-09-09 in d2a0275;
  • the CAUSE EDGE joining a fix to what it closed (CAUSES / INVALIDATES), enforced by the `fix_without_recorded_cause` detector — shipped 2026-09-06 in c681bb0.
A fix recorded on 2026-08-28 postdates the parent's cutoff and is therefore in the requirement's scope, but there was no cause-edge detector to obey and no convention it could have followed. Parking it under the parent alone would have read as a ruling contradicting its own stated date; that is why this node exists rather than 228 edges hanging off 2026-08-17.

THE MEASUREMENT (2026-09-09, against the export at docs/design/reflow2.json, byte-identical to the live graph):

  ChangeEvents of change_type defect_fix or test_failure_fix        259
  joined to a cause (CAUSES either way, or outgoing INVALIDATES)     31
  joined to NO cause                                                228   (88%)
  of those 228, recorded ON OR AFTER the 2026-09-06 detector          0

⭐ THE LAST LINE IS WHY THE BOUNDARY IS HONEST RATHER THAN CONVENIENT. Not one of the 228 postdates the detector, and every fix recorded since it landed carries its cause — 09-06, 09-06, 09-07 and onward, 100% compliance. The detector is not being ignored; it reported a backlog that accumulated while nothing asked. An unscoped check would go red on history rather than on violations, which is exactly the trap `dec:the-authority-check-guards-forward-not-backward` named for the third time in this project.

WHY PARKED AND NOT ACKNOWLEDGED, because the detector offers both and they say different things. Acknowledging `fix_without_recorded_cause` says THIS DESIGN DOES NOT RECORD CAUSES and stops the question being asked ever again, including of fixes made tomorrow. That is false here and would discard a discipline currently at 100%. Parking says these 228 SPECIFIC events are out of scope and leaves the detector live for everything after them — `is_parked` skips them and the evidence line reports the parked count, so the backlog stays visible as a number rather than vanishing.

⚠️ HOW THIS NODE CAME TO BE WRITTEN, recorded because the near-miss is the useful part. The parent decision was ACCEPTED on 2026-08-17 and the requirement's own statement was never updated to say so: it still ended "NOT YET DECIDED: … whether it is retro-fittable … Anthony's own words read as forward-only, but that is his call to make explicitly rather than mine to infer." A session on 2026-09-09 read that paragraph, took the fork to be open, and put it to Anthony a second time. He gave the same answer. NO HARM LANDED — the answers agree and the parent was found before anything was built on the duplicate — but the cost was a question the owner had already answered being asked again, which is how someone learns the tool is not listening. THE CAUSE IS STALE PROSE OUTLIVING THE DECISION THAT SETTLED IT, the same class `prose_currency` was built for on set_verification_status and which nothing checks on a Requirement. The requirement's statement was corrected in the same change as this node.

THIS DOES NOT CLOSE `req:a-fix-says-whether-it-corrected-the-cause`. Its clause (c) — the design can answer what still rests on a patch — is served by `repair_report`, which on the day this was written said UNSTATED for all 259. That is day-one for a field shipped the day before, not neglect, and the parent ruling already governs it: the disposition binds forward from its own landing and the 259 are not backfilled.
properties.name: The CAUSE-EDGE half binds from its own detector's landing on 2026-09-06 — an instrument cannot bind three weeks before it exists
properties.rationale: The requirement has two limbs whose instruments shipped three weeks apart, so one cutoff cannot serve both. The parent ruling fixed 2026-08-17 for the requirement; the cause-edge detector did not exist until 2026-09-06, so the ~90 fixes recorded between those dates were in the requirement's scope with no mechanism to comply with and no convention to follow. This narrows the cause-edge boundary to the detector's own landing, which the measurement supports rather than merely permits: zero of the 228 uncaused fixes postdate it and every fix since carries its cause. Parking rather than acknowledging keeps the detector live for everything after the boundary and keeps the backlog visible as a count.
